SENSEX CLIMBS BACK TO 83,000 AS 63,000 BANK NIFTY RECORD

On 19 November 2026 the Sensex reclaimed *83,000*, the Nifty topped *25,500* and the Bank Nifty crossed *63,000*. Foreign institutional investors bought over ₹1 lakh crore, with autos and banks leading the rally. 
The broad market rise signals strong investor confidence and highlights demand in banking and auto sectors, reinforcing positive sentiment for Indian equities.

For information only. Not investment advice.
